notes.title: About VR Support
notes.content:
If your VR equipment at the start WarFire no detection to, you can in the open WarFire root directory, find a name for the System.cfg file, use Notepad program in which an arbitrary line input the following commands
"sys_vr_support=1" (without double quotation marks)
And then, save the "System.cfg""
Start WarFire, test VR function
If you have any questions, you can send email to:
dingyuqing2000@dkgamesstudio.com
